title: Sasaki and Miyano
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: First-year Miyano is a self-conscious fan of boys' love (BL) manga who meets second-year Sasaki when Sasaki breaks up a schoolyard fight. Sasaki starts borrowing Miyano's BL manga, falls for him and is open about it, while Miyano slowly works out whether his own feelings are friendship or romance. A slow-burn high school romance focused on communication and consent.
life_message: It holds up patient, honest love that respects the other person's pace and lets them understand themselves.
